thread:
anya - PM: Quick thread: propose shipping "policy templates" for Optimize so customers pick risk/roi tier (conservative / balanced / aggressive). Templates should map to batching, caching, quant recommendations and default concordance SLOs.

sam - Eng: Love it. Implementation: templates = config objects (quant_level, batch_window_ms, cache_ttl, eval_threshold). Expose per-route overrides and per-tenant feature flags. Emit explain_id for each decision.

li - ML: Each template gets a concordance SLA band. conservative -> 0.5% max delta; balanced -> 1.5%; aggressive -> 3%. Tie alerts to these bands and auto-pause if breached.

maria - Solutions: For pilots, ship two templates: "Safe Saver" (conservative) and "Smart Saver" (balanced). Include a short contract clause: when ROI triggers X% sustained, we auto-opt-in expansion; when quality drops, auto-revert.

anya - PM: Also add "contract triggers": token-savings thresholds that can unlock wider rollout for that tenant. That way sales can promise upside while legal keeps quality guardrails.

sam - Eng: Technical notes: need an audit export endpoint (CSV/JSON) with explain_id, template_used, metrics snapshot. Retain raw per-recommendation logs 30d.

li - ML: Eval workflow: nightly canonical eval per tenant against template baseline. Immediate alert if SLA band violated. Add a small online compare (sampled A/B) for downstream KPI drift.

maria - Solutions: Customer UX: one-line template descriptions, tooltip for concordance band, and a single-button "revert all recommendations". Pilot comms will include sample explain payload examples.

ops-bot: deploy 2112233500 -> canary to optimize-policy-templates pool (tags: int8, conservative-cache)

anya - PM: Action list: sam -> feature flags + audit export by Fri; li -> template SLA defs + eval hook by Thu; maria -> pilot template docs + contract language by Tue. Reconvene next Wed 9am to approve pilot signups.
